key_points: UPS partnered with TikTok Shop to provide a no-box, no-label returns service through Happy Returns.
Bank of America lowered its price target for UPS due to near-term volume concerns.
UPS stock continues to offer a high dividend yield (~7%) despite being beaten down.
Media outlets flag both risks to traditional dividend stocks and buying opportunities for income investors.
No earnings surprises, guidance changes, or major regulatory news; the net effect is mixed.
